property_summary: For every caller and recipient, only the owner can successfully transfer the contract balance via withdrawAll(address) (i.e., withdrawAll should only succeed when msg.sender == owner); the mutant removes this check so some non-owner caller can withdraw funds and change address(c).balance to 0, violating the rule.
change_summary: Remove the require check so anyone can call withdrawAll and withdraw the contract balance to the provided recipient.
